title: Concept: App-private file written with world access in java — review required
description: In java, an application file is opened with a world-accessible mode. The sandbox normally makes the file private to the app uid; these modes widen it to every application on the device, including ones the user did not intend to trust. The flags are deprecated but remain functional on older API levels.
applicability: java Android applications with legacy file I/O.
risk: Cross-application data disclosure or tampering; MEDIUM severity.
